notes: UNV 神 → LCC 上帝: standard theological term difference, same H0430
UNV 這是頭一日 → LCC 是一日: 頭一/一 both map to H0259 (אֶחָד); 是 has no Hebrew equivalent (no copula in יוֹם אֶחָד), left unannotated
爲 (LCC traditional form of 為) left unannotated — Hebrew lamed is an inseparable prefix on the noun, not a standalone word
